rows.section: Hawaii corporate income and franchise taxes
rows.label: Franchise tax rate on banks and financial corporations
rows.note: Banks and other financial corporations pay the franchise tax (HRS chapter 241) on entire net income instead of the corporate income tax.
rows.source_title: Hawaii State Legislature: HRS 241-4 Tax on financial institutions

rows.section: Hawaii property tax: state rules
rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: The counties (City and County of Honolulu, Hawaii, Maui and Kauai counties)
rows.note: Hawaii's constitution reserves real property taxation exclusively to the counties (except Kalawao).
rows.source_title: Hawaii State Legislature: Constitution of the State of Hawaii, Article VIII, Section 3

rows.section: Hawaii property tax: state rules
rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: None at state level: each county assesses, sets rates and collects its own real property tax
rows.note: Unlike most states, Hawaii has no state agency supervising property assessment; contact the county real property assessment office.
rows.source_title: Hawaii State Legislature: Constitution of the State of Hawaii, Article VIII, Section 3

rows.section: Hawaii real estate transfer tax
rows.label: Conveyance tax rates (standard schedule)
rows.note: Rate is set by the property's value band and applies to the full consideration (HRS 247-2). No 2026 rate change was enacted.
rows.source_title: Hawaii State Legislature: HRS 247-2 Basis and rate of tax (conveyance tax)

rows.section: Hawaii real estate transfer tax
rows.label: Conveyance tax rates when the buyer cannot claim a home exemption
rows.note: Applies to sales of a condominium or single-family home where the purchaser is ineligible for a county homeowner's exemption (e.g. investors, second homes).
rows.source_title: Hawaii State Legislature: HRS 247-2 Basis and rate of tax (conveyance tax)

rows.section: Hawaii real estate transfer tax
rows.label: Minimum conveyance tax per transaction
rows.note: Leases count only if the unexpired term is five years or more.
rows.source_title: Hawaii State Legislature: HRS 247-2 Basis and rate of tax (conveyance tax)
